notes_for_editor: The only detailed source is the NGS station record (PID BL2178) copied on the Central US Lookouts Dodge page. It calls the structure a lookout house, not a tower, and gives no height, cab type, build date or removal date. The 1935 date is when the station was described, not necessarily when the lookout was built; the event is recorded as 'other' for that reason. Record coordinates come from FFLA and were not checked against a second source. Story is about 110 words. Next leads: Cavallerano, Fire in the Piney Woods (2025), and Texas Forest Service archives, for build and removal dates. The 2026-10-10 check changed the footings distance to the nearest corner, as the NGS record says.
